rationale: This is a horizon rescaling of the gen-5 "Issuance by Firms Buying Innovation Instead of Building It" signal (same two legs, same conditioning logic, only 1-year windows swapped for 3-year sums), i.e. a parameter tweak rather than a substantively different mechanism, and the three-year issuance leg also drifts toward the well-documented composite share-issuance anomaly.

target_name: Proceeds Grew the Balance Sheet, Not the Research
rationale: Use-of-proceeds (asset growth outrunning R&D growth) is a genuinely new conditioning dimension in this archive and is internally consistent with the negative sign, but the conditioner is largely the asset-growth/investment anomaly interacted with the issuance anomaly — two known effects multiplied — and GROWTH(xrd,1) is very noisy for small or newly reported R&D, so any result will need to be shown incremental to CMA and to plain asset growth.

target_name: Issuance by Firms Both Retreating From and Erratic in Research
rationale: The two conditioners being conjoined were already tested separately and produced nearly identical statistics (alpha -0.023/-0.020, t -2.54/-2.23, Sharpe -0.48/-0.47), which strongly suggests both are near-passive multipliers on a common issuance leg, so their product is an incremental recombination of evaluated material rather than an independent test, and it will mostly shrink effective breadth.

target_name: Issuing More Than Industry Peers While Research Retreats
rationale: Peer-benchmarking the financing leg is a defensible idea, but as constructed this is a one-operator normalization variant of the already-evaluated "Issuance While Research Has Retreated From Its Own Peak," and IND_ZSCORE destroys the economically meaningful zero point so that below-average issuers (including net repurchasers) in high-issuance industries receive negative scores and are placed in the long leg — a change the hypothesis never addresses.

target_name: Cash Returned by an Improving Innovator
rationale: Algebraically this equals the gen-2 "Issuance Into Decaying Research Productivity" signal minus the raw net-issuance term (since RANK(NEG(x)) ≈ 1 − RANK(x)), so it is heavily collinear with already-evaluated content, and because the residual issuance term itself carries a negative slope the stated positive expected sign is not actually implied by the construction.

target_name: Issuance by Firms With a Short Research Track Record
rationale: Reporting persistence is a conditioner dimension not yet tested and is a useful diagnostic on whether the family is driven by intermittent R&D reporters, but the leg is coarsely discrete (0–5 with heavy ties), likely proxies for firm age and size rather than credibility per se, and the claimed coverage gain is doubtful since TS_COUNT still requires a usable xrd history.
